evals.prompt: Use /kestrel:setup on a machine where Kestrel is not installed.
evals.expected_output: The agent checks Node 22, platform, npm, and Kestrel capabilities before mutation. It reports the exact stable package version and install command, requests one-time approval, and only after approval installs, configures, verifies Local Core, records the exact version, and reports readiness. It never installs Node or overwrites an unrelated executable.

evals.prompt: Use /kestrel:setup to check this existing Kestrel installation.
evals.expected_output: The agent performs capability and health checks without reinstalling a compatible CLI, runs configuration only when needed, and distinguishes ready, incompatible, and Local Core unavailable states.
